title: How do I invite team members to CloudDash?
content:
## Inviting team members

CloudDash supports team-based access with role-based permissions.

## Steps to invite
1. Go to **Settings → Team Management**.
2. Click **Invite Member**.
3. Enter the email address of the person to invite.
4. Select their role (see roles below).
5. Click **Send Invite**. They will receive an email with a sign-up link valid for 72 hours.

## Available roles

| Role | Permissions |
|------|-------------|
| **Owner** | Full access including billing and team management. One per organization. |
| **Admin** | All access except billing. Can invite/remove members. |
| **Member** | Can view and edit dashboards, alerts, and integrations. Cannot manage billing or team. |
| **Viewer** | Read-only access to dashboards and alerts. Cannot modify anything. |

## Plan limits
- **Starter**: up to 3 team members
- **Pro**: up to 15 team members
- **Enterprise**: unlimited team members

## Notes
- Pending invites can be cancelled from **Settings → Team Management → Pending Invites**.
- If an invite expires, you can resend it from the same page.
- SSO users are provisioned automatically — see KB-017 for SSO setup.
